description: Benchmark dataset covering pharmacological approvals, clinical treatment guidelines, side effects, and physiological facts.

corpus.title: FDA Approval & Dosing Guidelines for Metformin
corpus.text: Metformin was FDA approved in 1994 for type 2 diabetes mellitus management. Standard initial adult dosage is 500 mg twice daily with meals. It primary works by decreasing hepatic glucose production.

corpus.title: Hypertension Treatment Protocols (JNC 8 Guidelines)
corpus.text: First-line antihypertensive medications include thiazide-type diuretics, calcium channel blockers (CCBs), ACE inhibitors, and ARBs. Beta-blockers are no longer recommended as first-line therapy for uncomplicated hypertension.

corpus.title: Aspirin in Cardiovascular Disease Prevention
corpus.text: Low-dose aspirin (75-100 mg daily) is recommended for secondary prevention of cardiovascular events in patients with established coronary artery disease.

corpus.title: Antibiotic Stewardship for Viral Respiratory Infections
corpus.text: Antibiotics such as Amoxicillin are completely ineffective against viral respiratory infections like acute bronchitis and acute viral sinusitis.
